name: Zhu Shaoyan
source:
"Tonight you have 'til the count of 600. Got it?"

Zhu Shaoyan is a high-ranking member of the Qingyun Society, and one of [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url]'s top lieutenants. She serves as the Society's enforcer; dealing with internal conflicts and meting out punishment. A Waijia master known as the "Demon Empress," wielding long claws and a cyber-whip. [spoiler]Zhu is notorious for her sadomasochism and habit of raping and murdering young women.[/spoiler]

One of the five responsible for [url=/c7182]Kong Ruili[/url]'s rape and murder.
